description: Traceable Source & Factual Claim Database: Ensuring Scientific Rigor and Eliminating Unverified Fluff across all Content.

sources.author: vidIQ Research Team
sources.publication: vidIQ Channel Milestones & Upload Distribution Study
sources.datasetType: Public YouTube Data API catalog metrics across multiple creator tiers

claims.statement: The median best-of-10 long-form video earned 10.82x the views of the first upload.
claims.attributionRule: Must be cited as 'In our analysis of vidIQ's study of 448,413 YouTube channels...' Never claim Rank Kiwi scraped 448k channels first-party.
claims.caveats: Calculated on channels with at least 10 long-form uploads. Does not account for deleted, unlisted, or private test videos.

claims.statement: The top 10% of videos account for over 70% of total lifetime channel views across typical channels.
claims.caveats: Power-law distribution holds across gaming, education, and entertainment genres.

sources.author: Tubefilter / YouTube Official Statistics
sources.publication: Global YouTube Channel Size & Subscriber Milestones Analysis

claims.statement: Channels with 100,000+ subscribers represent less than 0.7% of all active YouTube channels.
claims.caveats: Includes all registered channels with at least one public video upload.

sources.author: Academic Open Data Consortium / Kaggle Dataset
sources.publication: Social Media Format Benchmark: 10,000 Public Instagram Posts
sources.datasetType: Public profile metrics across 1k to 500k follower accounts

claims.statement: Reels generate an average 2.1x higher non-follower reach, but carousels produce a 1.6x higher median save rate for accounts under 50,000 followers.
claims.caveats: Analyzed during a 90-day active window. Excludes paid promoted posts.

sources.author: Bhavishya Singla / Rank Kiwi Engineering
sources.publication: Outlier Score Mathematical Specification & Median Benchmark Engine
sources.datasetType: Mathematical formulation and local DOM extraction

claims.statement: Outlier Score = Post Views / Median Views of visible creator catalog. An Outlier Score of 3.2x indicates the post earned 3.2 times the creator's median benchmark.
claims.caveats: Requires a minimum sample of 12-24 visible posts to compute a statistically stable median baseline.

claims.statement: Rank Kiwi executes 100% locally in the browser sandbox. Analyzed creator content is never transmitted to or stored on external servers.
claims.caveats: Subject to browser memory limits when scanning very large grids.
